title: Allocation ring
description: A sculpted portfolio ring redistributes across years while a selected holding keeps its identity.
useCase: Inspect how an investment portfolio is divided, then compare the same holding across datasets.
interaction: Choose a year; hover, focus or select a holding.
reducedMotion: Finite transitions become immediate under reduced motion and keyboard input. Host pause disables controls; any owned drag is cancelled.
limitations: Fictional portfolio data; no market feed, performance projection or financial calculation beyond sums and shares. Four SVG segments, no chart runtime.
look: Near-black dashboard with a gradient donut of green, sand, steel-blue and grey segments inside a circle of ticks, a large balance figure and legend.
motion: Changing year slides each arc's dash length and offset to its new share (460 ms ease-out); hovering or selecting a holding thickens its arc and dims the rest.
adapt: Segments are SVG circles with `pathLength` 100 whose `strokeDasharray` and `strokeDashoffset` come from `segments`; the `.arc circle` rule transitions them over 460ms. Replace `HOLDINGS` and `PERIODS` with your data and keep `data-still` for keyboard and pause.
